claims: On fixed unnormalized T3, fixed nu>0 and E0>0, the existing FA/AJ smooth full unforced NS family disproves a uniform square-root-time L1_t L-infinity_x total-speed bound with constant depending only on E0 and nu.

The strictly positive windows have age and length comparable to N^(-5/2); integrated speed is at least c N^(-1), the square-root-time ratio at least c N^(1/4), and total dissipation on the construction window tends to zero as N^(-1/2).
The explicitly assumed time-chain windows are internally disjoint when delta<=alpha; the radius sum, a maximum-radius lower bound and the displacement estimate follow by integration and summation.
An explicitly non-NS scalar example has infinitely many geometric events and a square-root integral modulus on every time interval. It does not satisfy endpoint classical smoothness.
figure_reason: Pure analytic corollary and explicitly scalar example, no simulation or measured data.
integrity_note: This later manifest binds reviewed files from the scientific source commit; it does not hash itself or the later dispatch receipt. The checkpoint is a source-stage snapshot; current dispatch evidence lives in the separate receipt and research resume index.
limitations: Changing initial data, not one fixed solution or a fixed-positive-age/terminal-time counterexample.
Direct FA/AJ corollary, not a new construction, novelty, sharpness, priority or publication-value certification.
No unconditional critical control, valid periodic transplant of the external theorem, singularity or general regularity conclusion.
The scalar example is not an NS trajectory. One large radius does not bound the minimum or terminal radius.
Source PDF/HTML reading is scoped; no full Tao/external-dependency proof audit.
Only private archival is requested; no new public full text, core details, source attachments, daily-reader PDF or historical whitelist expansion.

No assumed gain, clock/norm variant or repeat FA construction; if no new same-solution input is obtained, record NO-CANDIDATE for that interface. General3D target remains OPEN.
